speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment of your fatigue, weight loss, and abnormal physical findings, please tell me your age and how long you have been experiencing these symptoms. Also, have you noticed any fever, night sweats, or changes in your appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you, Mr. Patient. Given your age, the 6-month history of fatigue and weight loss, and the notably good appetite, we must rule out malignancy or chronic infection. Have you noticed any lumps in your neck, armpits, or groin, or any persistent cough or hoarseness? Also, have you experienced any pain in your bones or joints?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have 5 kg unintentional weight loss over 6 months, Good appetite.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That confirms the classic B-symptoms of constitutional illness: fatigue, weight loss, and preserved appetite. To further evaluate for lymphoma or metastatic disease, have you noticed any persistent fevers, drenching night sweats, or any new lumps in your neck, axillae, or groin? Also, do you have any pain in your bones or joints?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Malignancy (suspected Lymphoma or Metastatic Carcinoma)
